summary.result: The results of this study are expected to be used as basic data for calculating the water footprint of rice fields and disseminating rice field water management technology for efficient management of agricultural water.
summary.background: Due to the recent water shortage caused by climate change, it is possible to evaluate water conservation effects through agricultural water policies and efficient water resource management by using the water footprint of rice fields,.
summary.method: The water management scenario applied to the model is Continuously Flooding(CF), Intermittent Drainage(ID), Alternate Wetting and Drying(AWD).
